blocks.t: Palmera uses artificial intelligence (“AI”) to enhance the user experience by helping users discover experiences, receive recommendations, organize itineraries, answer common questions, and interact with certain features of the platform.
This Policy explains how AI is used within Palmera and what users should expect when interacting with AI-powered features.
Palmera’s AI Concierge is designed to assist users with tasks such as:
Recommending restaurants, hotels, activities, and experiences;
Answering general questions about listings and bookings;
Providing recommendations based on user preferences; and
Responses generated by the AI Concierge are intended to improve convenience and should be considered informational recommendations rather than professional advice.
Certain services may be provided by members of the Palmera team rather than artificial intelligence.
As Palmera expands, users may have access to additional concierge services, including premium human concierge features available through Palmera Plus or other eligible offerings.
Where reasonably possible, Palmera will make it clear whether a user is interacting with an AI system or a human representative.
Although we strive to provide accurate and helpful recommendations, AI-generated responses may occasionally be inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unsuitable for your particular situation.
Users should independently verify important information, including but not limited to:
The official information provided by the Provider will always control in the event of any inconsistency.
Palmera’s AI features do not provide legal, financial, tax, medical, safety, or other professional advice.
Users should consult qualified professionals before making decisions requiring professional expertise.
Recommendations generated by Palmera’s AI are based on available information, user preferences, booking history, and other relevant platform data where applicable.
Recommendations are intended to improve the user experience and should not be interpreted as guarantees, endorsements, or rankings of any Provider or experience.
To improve the quality of recommendations and concierge services, Palmera may use information that users choose to provide, including:
Other information described in our Privacy Policy.
Palmera does not use AI to make solely automated decisions that have legal or similarly significant effects on users.
Users may not use Palmera’s AI features to:
Reverse engineer or abuse AI systems; or
Engage in any activity that violates Palmera’s Terms of Service.
AI-powered features may be modified, improved, temporarily unavailable, or discontinued at any time without prior notice.
Palmera does not guarantee uninterrupted availability of AI services.
Palmera may update this AI Policy and AI Concierge Disclosure from time to time to reflect changes in technology, applicable laws, or platform features.
The most current version will always be available on the Palmera platform.
